response.text:
Understood — I won’t open or change the deck.

Recommendation: drop slide 6 (Architecture) and slide 7 (Security).

Why: Architecture and security are detailed, technical deep-dives that eat time but aren’t needed to make a clear ten-minute business narrative. Removing them keeps the flow focused on the market, problem, solution, traction/pricing, team, and the ask — the pieces investors or executives typically care about in a short pitch. Any essential technical or security claims can be summarized in one sentence inside “Our approach” or moved to an appendix for follow-up questions.

Caveat: if you’re presenting to a technical or infosec audience where architecture/security are decision criteria, instead consider dropping Case Study (9) and Roadmap (10) — they’re valuable for credibility and planning but can be condensed or shared afterward.
